claims.sentence: A randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled 2x2 factorial design will be conducted to assess the effect of a micronutrient with or without omega-3 fatty acids on cognitive development and performance and other selected outcome variables such as growth, morbidity and immune response in children of 7-9 years of age in India.
